nodes.label: BuildAI User Story Index (BuildAI-User-Stories.xlsx)
nodes.rationale: Version 2 du 25/11/2026: index of 44 user stories (US-001..US-044), 180 points total, 72 points remaining; 25 stories exist, 4 partially exist, 15 to implement. Story details (criteria, scenarios) are kept in BuildAI-Suivi-User-Stories.docx; 'Assigné à' column still to fill.

nodes.label: Epic: Recherche documentaire et RAG hybride
nodes.rationale: Learners ask technical BTP questions in natural French; BM25 (Elasticsearch) is combined with vector search (Qdrant) to catch both exact technical terms and rephrased questions; trainer persona makes answers pedagogical; model chosen via config to adapt to hardware without rebuild.
nodes.norm_label: epic: recherche documentaire et rag hybride

nodes.label: Epic: Traçabilité documentaire et PDF
nodes.rationale: Numbered clickable citations let engineers verify the source of a calculation or rule; cited PDFs are stored and served locally so links never die (no 404 / vanished site).

nodes.label: Epic: Génération de cours multi-agents
nodes.rationale: Trainers request a course on a theme, get a structured outline, agents write each chapter from the document base, export to .docx/Markdown; stopping a long generation (US-012) frees the GPU for chat without restarting the server.

nodes.label: Epic: QCM et évaluations
nodes.rationale: Generate 5-10 question MCQs on a BTP theme, with an explanation per question so learners understand mistakes, exported as separate student and answer-key versions. Entirely to implement.

nodes.label: Epic: Ingestion et préparation des données
nodes.rationale: Scrape btp-cours.com and geniecivilpdf.com automatically; reject social-share pages and external scripts to avoid fake login forms/malicious content; chunk into 500-900 char overlapping passages so formulas/sentences are not cut; one script indexes into both Elasticsearch and Qdrant to keep indexes consistent; incremental reindexing avoids recomputing everything.
nodes.norm_label: epic: ingestion et preparation des donnees

nodes.label: Epic: Interface utilisateur
nodes.rationale: Chat UI usable on desktop and tablet, conversation history side panel, keyword search across conversations, proper rendering of formulas and tables, switch between Q&A assistant and course generator.

nodes.label: Epic: Navigation et partage des conversations
nodes.rationale: Fork a conversation from a message, edit prompts keeping old versions, view the conversation as a branch tree, restart from any node, share by link so a student continues, ask a question about a selected excerpt. Mostly LibreChat evolutions.
nodes.norm_label: epic: navigation et partage des conversations

nodes.label: Epic: Infrastructure et déploiement
nodes.rationale: One-command reproducible install (docker compose up -d); Ollama on NVIDIA GPU for speed; Bearer token protects documents and GPU; stay under 4 GB VRAM to avoid OOM crashes on mid-range GPUs; health endpoint for Docker checks; secrets out of versioned files; CI tests on every push; GPU/latency monitoring.

nodes.label: Sprint 5 (2026-11-30 to 2026-12-11)
nodes.rationale: Objectif: sécuriser et fiabiliser le déploiement, poser les tests automatiques.

nodes.label: Sprint 6 (2027-01-04 to 2027-01-15)
nodes.rationale: Objectif: améliorer la qualité des données et du RAG.

nodes.label: Sprint 7 (2027-01-18 to 2027-01-29)
nodes.rationale: Objectif: QCM côté serveur et premières évolutions de LibreChat.

nodes.label: Sprint 8 (2027-02-01 to 2027-02-12)
nodes.rationale: Objectif: fonctionnalités bonus si le temps le permet.

nodes.label: Sprint Capacity Plan (18 points/sprint)
nodes.rationale: Two-person team, two-week sprints, ~18 points capacity per sprint; no sprint during holidays 14/12-03/01; 21 stories / 74 points planned across sprints 5-8, 0 points left unplanned.

nodes.label: RAG API Bearer Token Auth
nodes.rationale: Prevents unauthorized access to documents and GPU.

nodes.label: NVIDIA GPU / 4 GB VRAM budget
nodes.rationale: Keep platform under 4 GB VRAM to avoid out-of-memory crashes on mid-range GPUs; run Ollama on GPU when available to avoid saturating CPU.

nodes.label: Passage chunking (500-900 chars, overlap)
nodes.rationale: Improves retrieval without cutting a formula or a sentence.
